Interface HasParents<T>

Type Parameters:
T - The type of the parent objects.
All Known Implementing Classes:
GLine, GPoint
public interface HasParents<T>
An interface for objects that can be part of a composite structure, allowing them to maintain references to their parent or owner objects.

This is particularly useful in a scene graph or a composite geometry system where child objects (e.g., a GPoint) need to notify their parent objects (e.g., a GLine or GTri) of changes. By implementing this interface, an object can track multiple parents that depend on its state.

Author:
Lehlogonolo Poole
